rdl_db.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
rdl_db.notes: Hinge at hips, soft knee, lower until hamstring stretch, drive hips forward to return.

abdominal_crunch.name: Abdominal Crunch
abdominal_crunch.notes: Brace your core and curl your ribcage toward your pelvis. Pause briefly at peak contraction, return without letting the stack drop.

arnold_press.name: Arnold Press
arnold_press.notes: Find comfortable grip! Press in an arc from in front of face to overhead. Rotation is passive, not forced. Stop before lower back takes over.

barbell_curl.name: Barbell Curl
barbell_curl.notes: Keep elbows still. Small body swing is OK only near hard reps. Do not turn it into a hip drive.

bench_db.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
bench_db.notes: Lower slow. Press straight up. Do not bounce or rush the bottom.

bench_db_incline.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
bench_db_incline.notes: Press up and slightly in. Do not turn into shoulder press.

back_ext.name: Back Extension Machine
back_ext.notes: Move at hips. Stop when body is straight. Do not lean past straight.

reverse_pd.name: Reverse Peck Deck
reverse_pd.notes: Pull out and back. Do not use traps or momentum.

glute_kickback.name: Glute Kickback Machine
glute_kickback.notes: Push back with heel. Keep hips still. Squeeze at the top.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer Curl
hammer_curl.notes: Neutral grip throughout. Curl to shoulder. No swinging. Slow down on the way down.

lat_pull.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pull.notes: Pull down to chest. Keep body still. No swinging.

lateral_raise_machine.name: Seated Lateral Raise Machine
lateral_raise_machine.notes: Controlled reps only. Keep constant tension, stop at shoulder height, no shrugging. Stay in the rep range even on fatigued days.

lat_raise.name: Lateral Raise
lat_raise.notes: Raise out to the sides. Slight elbow bend stays the same. No swinging, Slow eccentric.

leg_curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
leg_curl.notes: Curl down and back. Control the return. Do not cut range short, curl to 90°+.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.notes: Push smoothly. Control depth. Do not lift hips. Knees track over toes, lower to 90°.

ohp.name: Overhead Press
ohp.notes: Press straight up. Keep body tight. Do not lean back. Lock out at top.

row_dumbbell.name: Supported Single-Arm Row
row_dumbbell.notes: Pull to your side. Keep body still. Do not twist. Row to hip, not shoulder.

row_machine.name: Seated Row Machine
row_machine.notes: Drive elbows back, pause 1s at peak contraction. Do not rock your body.

skull_crushers.name: Skull Crushers
skull_crushers.notes: Bend and extend elbows only. Keep upper arms still. Lower to forehead/crown, full extension up.

tri_press.name: Triceps Press Machine
tri_press.notes: Push down and lock out. Keep elbows in place, controlled return.
